title: stepd ConformanceManifest
description: Served at GET {app_url}/.well-known/stepd-conformance by an app under test. `suites` is what the app claims to implement; a runner may not certify a level containing a suite the app did not declare.

sdk.description: Language and version, for the report. Informational.

suites.description: Suites this app implements every required function for. Declaring a suite it cannot satisfy is worse than omitting it: an omitted suite is reported as not declared, a declared one as failed.

statically_prevented.description: Hazards this implementation makes unrepresentable rather than detectable at run time. The runner relays these as passed by construction and does not verify them, so the enum is closed: a runner must never be able to be told to skip an assertion by a value it does not recognise.
